subject: Quick snapshot from our call — one question on priority
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Moore <jordan@luminary.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 3 May 2027 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick snapshot from our call — one question on priority

Jordan — thanks again for taking the time today. Quick snapshot from our discussion and a single question at the bottom. Attaching my raw discovery notes (short).

Key points we covered:
- Primary need: reduce latency and TCO for batch document summarization across ML inference pipelines (50–200 reqs/sec, 4–8k token windows).
- Current constraint: unpredictable latency during peak batch jobs; on-prem GPUs handled by SRE team but scheduling is brittle.
- Success metric: consistent 99th percentile latency < 350ms and cost per 1k tokens under your current profile.

Suggested pilot (what we've seen work for similar infra teams):
- 4-week technical pilot running a subset of the pipeline (ingest + inference) with blackbox metrics collection; Redwood provides dedicated test capacity and observable dashboards.
- Two-week ramp: baseline -> A/B model routing -> KV cache exercise -> cost/latency report.

Attached: 20270503-discovery-notes.pdf (raw notes + proposed scope).

One question: would you classify this as a top-3 priority for the platform roadmap for the next quarter?
- Yes: we’ll prioritize a short pilot and I’ll loop in a solutions engineer.
- No or low: I’ll hold off and check back at a later cadence.

Can you reply with a quick Yes/No or pick one of these 15-minute slots to talk through scope next week?
1) Tue 5/4, 10:30–10:45 PT
2) Wed 5/5, 2:00–2:15 PT

Thanks — appreciate the candor.

— Mina
Mina Haddad
Senior AE, Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0142
